title: Testing And CI/CD
summary: Verification discipline for tests, build checks, pipeline health, release safety, and observability signals.
instructions: Map every meaningful change to the cheapest reliable verification.
Prefer targeted tests during development and broader checks before handoff.
When checks fail, record the command, failure, likely cause, and next action.
Keep CI deterministic and avoid hiding failures behind permissive scripts.
evidenceRequirements: Test scripts or CI workflow definitions
Actual command output for verification claims
